text: Matteo is coeliac, properly, not just avoiding bread. He also can't stand coriander. Worth remembering before the dinner at ours on Saturday at 7.

Aditi's dad had a fall on Tuesday evening and fractured his wrist. She's driving up to Leeds tomorrow morning to stay with him for a few days. He's refusing to use the sling and her mum is apparently at the end of her tether with him. Aditi said she'll be back on Sunday night, and she'd love a walk on Monday to decompress.
Remind me to text Joe on Thursday afternoon to see how his knee scan went.
Kasia has gone vegan since September. Her partner Ivan hasn't, and apparently it's causing some friction at dinner time.
Called Grace. Her little boy Theo has had a temperature since Sunday night and they're seeing the GP at 10:40 tomorrow. She sounded exhausted. I should ring her the next day to check how he is.
Dawit only drinks oat milk flat whites and hates anything with cinnamon in it.
Stefan's mum has her hip replacement on the 14th at half 8 in the morning. He's taking the whole week off and staying with her afterwards. Don't forget to send him a message that evening.
Imogen and her husband are hosting Christmas this year for both families. Her sister Mia is bringing the twins, and Mia's allergic to nuts, so Imogen is panicking about the menu.
Need to pick up my prescription before 6 on Friday.
Ali mentioned he's been off work with a slipped disc for nearly three weeks. He's going stir crazy at home and says the physio is the only thing keeping him sane.
Jess loves a good negroni, and she said her favourite restaurant is the little Sicilian place on Hope Street. Could be a nice birthday idea in March.

Spoke to Reza after the match. His daughter Zara broke her arm at trampolining on Saturday morning. She's in a cast for six weeks and he says she's mostly upset about missing the swimming gala the week after. His wife is taking her to the fracture clinic on Friday at 9:30, and Reza's covering the school run that morning. Zara wants everyone to sign her cast.
Gareth's wedding tasting is on Wednesday at 2pm. He and Petra still can't agree on the cake; she wants lemon, he wants chocolate.
Must ask Liam how his dad's heart check went on Monday morning.
Svetlana doesn't drink at all, so get some decent alcohol-free fizz in for the party.

Chioma's mum is in hospital again with her chest. Chioma is flying to Lagos on the 3rd, first thing in the morning, and won't be back until the 17th. She's quite worried but trying to keep it together. Her brother is already there and sending updates. Remind me to message her on the 4th once she's landed and settled, and again the day before she flies home.
Had lunch with Siddharth and Saanvi. They've both cut out sugar for a month as a challenge. Saanvi is doing much better at it than he is, and she wouldn't let him forget it.
Lorenzo's dinner party next Friday is off because his flatmate has Covid. He'll reschedule for the week after, probably the Saturday.
I'm doing the dessert for Marta's birthday lunch on Sunday at 1. Remember she can't have dairy, so it'll have to be the sorbet again.
Gintaras has been struggling since his surgery. The wound got infected and he's back on antibiotics until the 22nd. Remind me to pop round with some soup on Thursday evening.
Jaya told me her son Arjun has glandular fever. He's missed two weeks of college and she's worried he'll fall behind before his mocks in January.
Samir's big presentation is Monday at 9am and he's really nervous about it. Text him good luck on Sunday night, then ask how it went that afternoon.

Dong said his wife is expecting again, due in early April. She's had terrible morning sickness this time round. He's being very sweet about it all, doing every school run and cooking all the meals because she can't face the smell of onions. Their eldest, Ali, is excited about being a big brother.

Aidan and Julien are off to Lisbon on the 9th. Aidan is pescatarian, Julien will eat literally anything. They fly back the following Tuesday. Julien's mum is house-sitting and looking after their cat Pesto while they're away. Aidan asked me to recommend somewhere for seafood, so I should send him that list from my trip.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month, ideally a Saturday morning.
Sadia's dog Biscuit had to have a tooth out yesterday. She was more stressed than Biscuit was. The vet wants to see him again a week after.

Mia's brother Ivan has just been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. He's twenty-four and finding it a lot to take in. Mia is going over to his on Saturday to help him sort out his meals. Their mum keeps ringing him three times a day, which isn't helping. Mia thinks a cookbook for diabetics might be a nice thing to give him.
Joe Murphy's retirement do is on the 28th at 7 at the cricket club. His wife is organising it and has asked everyone to keep it quiet. I should chip in for the card and the gift.
Matteo said his partner Aditi is gluten free too, so they're the easiest couple to cook for. Both love spicy food, the hotter the better.
Quick note: Stefan prefers red wine, Gareth only drinks lager, and Petra is teetotal.
Grace called back. Theo's temperature finally broke last night and he went back to nursery this morning. Huge relief.
Kasia's grandma passed away on Sunday. The funeral is in Kraków on the 30th and she's flying out the day before with her brother Marek. Send her a card this week.
Remind me to ask Dawit whether his sister got the results from her blood tests.
Zara's ninth birthday party is the Saturday after next, from 2 till 4. She's obsessed with axolotls at the moment, so anything axolotl themed would be perfect.
Saw Ali at the pharmacy this morning. He's finally starting back at work on Monday, but only half days for the first fortnight.
Imogen is off caffeine because of her migraines. She said decaf is fine but only before lunch, oddly.

Reza's wife Svetlana Reyes starts chemotherapy on Thursday at 11. Reza says she's being very calm about it, but he's not sleeping. Their kids don't fully understand what's happening yet. I must check in with him the day after and offer to take the kids one evening.
Julien is cooking a full French dinner for his parents' anniversary on the 18th. Forty years married. He's been practising the beef bourguignon every weekend.
I'm taking Svetlana to her eye appointment on Wednesday at 3:15, so I'll need to leave work early.
Jess's partner Samir has been signed off with stress for a month. She's holding everything together with the kids, and I think she's struggling more than she lets on.
Lorenzo hates mushrooms with a passion. Do not put them in anything.

Liam's dad is home from hospital now. The doctors want him back for a follow-up scan on the 2nd in the morning. Liam's going with him and then working from home that afternoon. His mum wants a quiet Sunday lunch for the family the weekend after, and Liam said his dad is already demanding roast potatoes despite the new low-salt diet.
Chatted to Petra on the phone for ages. Her daughter Lily got into the county youth orchestra, and her son has chickenpox, so the house is equal parts celebration and calamine lotion.
Siddharth (Sid to everyone) has a nut allergy, the serious EpiPen kind. Check the bakery labels before ordering the cake for his leaving drinks on Friday at 5.
Must buy more coffee and bin bags.

Gareth said his brother Dylan's stag weekend in Dublin has been cancelled because the best man broke his leg. They might just do a curry instead. Dylan is gutted, but honestly I think he's relieved not to fly. The wedding itself is still on for the 23rd of November at 1pm, and Gareth is doing a reading, which he's dreading.
Don't forget to ask Marta how her mum's cataract operation went. It was this morning at 10.
Saanvi is training for the Cardiff half marathon on the 5th. She's carb loading the two days before and has banned me from tempting her with cake until afterwards.

Aidan hasn't been himself lately. His mum's dementia is getting worse and he's going to see her every Sunday afternoon now. He said he'd like to get out for a pint sometime, so I should invite him for Thursday.
Dong Zhou's kids both have norovirus. The whole family is cancelling the trip to his in-laws this weekend.
Chioma has been to see a nutritionist and now eats no red meat. Still loves jollof, obviously.
Plan for Saturday: gym at 8, farmers market afterwards, then batch cook for the week.
Remind me to send Sadia the recipe for that lentil soup tomorrow evening. She's been trying to eat more plant-based since her cholesterol results.
Ivan Petrov twisted his ankle playing five-a-side on Tuesday night. He's on crutches and furious about missing the derby on the 12th.
Jaya and her husband are both on a low-FODMAP diet for his IBS. She says it's made them both miserable but his stomach is much better.
Gintaras is a whisky man, specifically Islay. He said he'd love a bottle of Lagavulin one day, which is a good hint for his fortieth in December.

Had coffee with Kasia and Zara this morning. Zara's mum is in hospital with pneumonia and Kasia is covering her shifts all week. Zara's visiting her each evening after work. Kasia is going in on Friday at 6 too. I need to message Zara on Saturday morning to see how her mum is doing, and maybe drop off some food the day after.
Mia's partner Julien is lactose intolerant, but he still orders the cheese board every single time.
Dawit's sister got the all clear from her blood tests. He was so relieved he bought a round for the whole table.
Need to call the dentist first thing tomorrow to move my appointment.
